info.title: gitsnapshotter
info.description: Command-line tool that takes a snapshot of a git repository's branches, tags, remotes, HEAD and (optionally) working tree, and restores it later.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Takes a snapshot of a git repository's branches, tags, remotes, HEAD and (optionally) working tree, and restores it later.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: List what changed in the repository since the snapshot was taken.

arguments.description: A snapshot written by the snapshot command.

arguments.name: SNAPSHOT_FILE

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description: Take a snapshot. Prints JSON, or writes it to the --output file.

options.name: --output
